name: Dual-Domain Interaction
aliases: spatial and transfer function domain interaction
definition: An interaction paradigm where the transfer function is set by direct interaction in the spatial domain (volume), with observation of the transfer function domain, reversing the traditional process of setting TF then observing volume.
summary: Dual-Domain Interaction reverses traditional volume rendering by letting users probe spatial features to directly set transfer function parameters, bridging the conceptual gap between 3D geometry and abstract data space.
